afirmacao.enunciado: O UniProt/Swiss-Prot (Tox-Prot) anota função para Snake venom metalloproteinase atroxlysin-I de Bothrops atrox.
afirmacao.passagem: Snake venom zinc metalloproteinase, which causes strong hemorrhagy and dermonecrosis by degrading the extracellular matrix (PubMed:20102699, PubMed:28767072). Its strong hemorrhagic activity is independent of binding to extracellular matrix (ECM) proteins and is instead due to its high catalytic activity, in contrast to P-III metalloproteinases, which bind to the ECM but have lower catalytic activity (PubMed:28767072). Its unique dermonecrotic action may be explained by its efficacy in laminin hydrolysis (Probable). Cleaves Xaa-Leu bonds (PubMed:20102699, PubMed:32024243). Hydrolyzes fibrinogen, fibrin, fibronectin (FN1), type I collagen, type IV collagen, laminin, nidogen, integrin alpha-7/beta-1 (ITGA7/ITGB1) and integrin alpha-1/beta-1 (ITGA1/ITGB1) (PubMed:20102699, PubMed:28767072, PubMed:32024243). Binds to fibronectin (FN1) and fibrinogen (PubMed:20102699). Shows no or very weak binding to type I collagen and laminin, and no binding to type IV collagen and nidogen (PubMed:20102699, PubMed:28767072). Inhibits ADP- and collagen-induced platelet aggregation both in the presence (IC(50)=1.4 uM for collagen) and in the absence (IC(50)=2.2 uM for collagen) of cofactors (PubMed:20102699). Is involved in the inflammatory reaction observed in B.atrox envenomation (PubMed:32024243). Acts by direct action on inflammatory cells by releasing pro-inflammatory peptides from basal membrane proteins, but does not induce inflammatory mediator release (PubMed:32024243)
